neighbours.label: Statements that a product or system is rolled out or fitted as it stands: 'is available in', 'can be installed', 'at the same time/visit as', 'considering adoption' (the - pole takes the other side: adding to or modifying something)
fire: Nine clinics already run the software and three more are weighing adoption.
The bracket can be mounted at the same time as the panel.
The tool was added to the suite as part of a scheduled update, giving users new charts.
The extension is available in the Chrome Web Store from today.
The kit can be assembled in two or three hours by one person.
Forty schools use the programme and several districts are looking at implementation.
The veneer can be applied at the same appointment as the whitening.
The driver is available as a free download for all current models.
quiet: Nine hikers reached the summit and three more turned back.
The river rises in the hills and flows south to the sea.
The actor was praised for his role as a tired detective.
The fox ran across the field and vanished in the hedge.
The storm passed over the island in two or three hours.
Forty sheep grazed on the hill while the dog slept.
The engine needed heavy modification before it would run on ethanol.
The poem was written in the winter of 1820.

notes: Card flags broad (1.3% of tokens reach 0.1 of max). Probes are weak: 'considering adoption' 0.64, 'at the same visit' 0.33, 'at the same time' 0.29, 'available in the App Store' 0.22, 'as part of the spring release' 0.20; a sentence about modification also 0.22. Output suppresses ' modified', ' modification', ' altered'. Expect a fail or a marginal result.
